instruction: Delete the last slide from the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to set blue background on all 19 slides. Successfully navigated slide panel, scrolled through all 19 slides, and interacted with right-click context menus. Failed to complete background task but demonstrated slide panel navigation.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate slide panel, scroll through slides, right-click on slides for context menu, select individual slides. Demonstrated ability to interact with the slide panel throughout the trajectory.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed at the 'apply to all' aspect of background changes, but showed clear ability to navigate and interact with the slide panel where delete operations are performed.
metadata.task_rationale: Model demonstrated strong slide panel navigation skills. Deleting a slide is a simple right-click > Delete action on the slide panel, which is within the model's demonstrated capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires deleting the last slide (slide 19). Getter reads pptx and counts slides, metric checks count equals 18 (original has 19). Simple single-action task in the slide panel.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the pptx file and counts slides using python-pptx, returning {'slide_count': count}.
Metric correctly accesses expected parameter: since expected.type='rule', get_rule returns {'expected_count': 18} directly, and expected.get('expected_count', 0) works correctly.
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before the getter reads it, ensuring fresh state.
Expected value of 18 is correct given the original presentation has 19 slides.

Incomplete coverage: The evaluator only checks that the total slide count is 18, but does not verify that specifically the LAST slide was deleted. Deleting any of the 19 slides would result in count=18 and pass the check. This means a false positive is possible if the agent deletes a different slide.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: To fully verify the instruction, also check the content/identity of the remaining slides to confirm that slides 1-18 are intact and the original slide 19 is missing. For example, compare the title or content of the last remaining slide against the original slide 18's content.
Alternatively, check that the last slide's content matches the original slide 18 (not slide 19) to confirm the correct slide was removed.
